title: Finally pushed out a massive update
author: TalesofEternitydev

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
'I know with ai this game is just a drop in the bucket but it is actually something i have dreamed my entire life of being able to do so take that as you will. '

...I am very tired of people who say, 'I have been dreaming of this game my whole life', and what they post is clearly just an extraordinarily crappy clone of a different game. 

No, you haven't been dreaming of this your whole life. No, this is not a realized lifelong ambition. 

It's just slop.

comments.author: TalesofEternitydev
comments.body: i just saw your edit now and maybe i need to work on the cover art as it could give off the wrong message, but i do want to reiterate i have never played runescape (so i dont think i can clone something ive never experienced).  I wanted to go with a combat system that would be feasible to someone who has 0 experience coding or game deving which would be turn based.  Which happens to be something I honestly do enjoy since i love the pokemon games, so thats why im going with it dont think i am advanced enough to shoot for something more complicated.  The art is obviously dog shit but i just started this 4 weeks ago and have been focusing purely on the gameplay aspects of it and will upgrade the visuals later on once ive learned more and maybe hired an artist.  but again thanks i do appreciate the feedback even if it negative because believe it or not this is a passion project and the end result will reflect it.  This is just the start.
